subject: baku
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A stocky dream-eating baku spirit — an indigo tapir with a short trunk, cream saddle and gold trappings — built in flat ukiyo-e woodblock colours, with glowing dream wisps curling toward its trunk.
spec.layout: A quadruped spirit facing +Z, standing on four short sturdy pillar legs, feet flat on y = 0. The barrel torso runs z -1.3 (rump) to 1.3 (shoulder), belly at y 0.55, broad back at y 1.85, deep indigo like printed Prussian blue. A bold cream saddle band wraps the flank mid-body (the Malayan-tapir saddle) with a zig-zag ink edge; stylised ukiyo-e wave-scroll and seigaiha scallop pieces in pale mist-blue and gold sit as flat raised pieces on the upper flank, and a cream underbelly reads cooler and paler below. Front: a boxy skull on a short thick neck, small dark rhinoceros eyes with glowing gold irises set wide, a cream forehead blaze, and a short tapir trunk that droops from the face down to y 0.45 and curls slightly inward at the tip, ringed with faint gold bands; a two-piece jaw under it opens, with a dark vermillion-lined mouth and small cream tusks at the jaw corners. Large oval ox ears stand up at y ~2.2, dark outside, coral inside, gold-rimmed. A mane crest of broad ink-tipped blades runs along the spine from shoulder to rump (part 4) and an ox tail with a glowing gold tuft sweeps up behind the rump to z -1.9. Around the feet and flanks, a few flat stylised cloud wisps in mist-blue trail, and three or four glowing dream motes spiral in toward the trunk tip, as if being eaten. Every part wears ukiyo-e style: flat colours, thin sumi-ink outline strips seated along seams and edges, gold fittings, hard zig-zag colour breaks, no gradients.

parts.builds: The barrel torso and its print decoration. Build the spine between the 'spine' and 'chest' joints with a b.chain plus one b.loft or b.sweep over both joints (bone: [spine, chest]) for a smooth-skinned barrel: stations from rump (z -1.35, half-width 0.6, top y 1.85) swelling through the belly (lowest point y 0.55) to the shoulder (z 1.35), belly slightly deeper than the chest, rump rounded. Coat: countershade of 'indigo' on top toward 'cream' on the belly with a hard break, per ukiyo-e flat colour (use sectors or furEdge-style hard level, never a soft gradient). The cream saddle band: a second material band or swept sleeve ringing the barrel between z -0.15 and z 0.65, cream, with a zig-zag ink strip ('sumi') seated along both its top and bottom edges as its own thin swept line. Decoration on the upper flank, all as separate flat pieces seated just proud of the skin: three or four stylised wave-scroll swirls (extruded comma shapes, 'mist' with 'sumi' outline edges) on each side around the saddle, and a row of small seigaiha scallop discs ('cream' with 'gold' rims) arcing along the top of the back on each side. Gold trim: a thin gold band swept around the barrel just behind the shoulder and again at the flank under the saddle edge, each with tiny gold stud spheres. Add a vermillion circular family crest emblem (a flat extruded disc, vermillion with a gold ring and a small sumi swirl inside) seated high on each shoulder. A short sumi-ink mane strip runs along the topline. Belly is cream, shading to creamShade at the lowest faces; underside gets a faint indigoInk seam line where belly meets flank.
parts.attaches: Roots the neck at the 'neck' joint through neckMount (the head part continues the neck tube forward from there); the four legs socket into it at socketFL/FR/HL/HR (the legs part builds the limbs, this part builds the socket shadow rings of indigoInk on the skin around each socket); the tail mounts at tailMount and the mane crest sits along maneMount (both built by part 4).

parts.builds: The head, face, trunk, ears and jaw — the signature part, richest construction. Continue the neck: a b.sweep tube from the chest through neckMount to the 'head' joint at [0, 1.62, 1.72], thick (radius ~0.28 tapering to 0.24), indigo, with a cream throat patch under it and a gold collar band at neckMount with small gold studs. The skull: a chunky boxy dome (lathe or loft) centred on the head joint, forehead at y ~2.0, cheeks flaring wider than the neck, indigo, with a cream blaze strip running from forehead down the front of the face between the eyes. Eyes: two bold dark parts — sumi almond outline plates seated on the skull sides at the head joint's local [±0.16, 0.05, 0.1], each holding a gold-glowing iris disc (glow the iris at strength ~1.2, colour dreamGold with a sumi vertical-slit pupil part on top); a sumi brow ridge bar above each. Ears on earL/earR: large oval ox ears (extruded outlines, thickness tapering to a knife edge), sumi/indigo outside, coral inside cup, gold rim strip along the outer edge, each root buried in a small fur rosette of indigo blades. Trunk: a b.sprout trunk chain (trunk1..trunk3) from the front of the face at [0, 1.5, 1.95] curving down and slightly forward, radius ~0.16 at base tapering to 0.09 at the curling tip at y 0.45, indigoDeep, with three pale gold ring bands seated around it (thin swept loops, gold) and a soft nostril pair (small sumi discs) at the tip underside. Jaw: separate upper and lower jaw built on the 'jaw' joint — the lower jaw a short frustumBox slab under the muzzle, indigo, its inner mouth lined vermillion, with two small cream tusks curving up at the jaw corners and a cream chin patch; the mouth line between jaws is a thin sumi strip so the jaw can open. Finish with sumi outline strips seated along the skull-cheek seam and neck-back seam for the woodblock line work.
parts.attaches: The neck tube roots inside the body part at the 'chest' joint and passes through neckMount; the trunk tip hovers above trunkMouth, where the aura part's dream wisps converge; ears and jaw hang from the head joint; nothing overlaps the body's barrel forward of z 1.3.

parts.builds: Four short, sturdy pillar legs, tiger-pawed. Build each leg as a b.chain through its hip/knee/ankle joints (use limb() from hip joint to a foot target at [±0.56, 0.09, ±0.98] with slight knee-forward bend) and sweep it as one smooth-skinned tube: radius ~0.19 at the hip swelling slightly at the thigh, tapering to ~0.13 at the ankle, indigo. Front pair attaches under the shoulder sockets, rear pair under the hips, roots buried into the body skin. Tiger-paw banding: three or four short vermillion or cream chevron bands wrapped around each upper leg (thin swept rings or bands on the sweep), placed only on the thigh and knee, not the cannon. Feet: broad three-toed paws — a frustumBox or squashed lathe pad at each ankle, cream on top fading to sumi toe tips, each toe its own small rounded prism with a sumi claw tip; the soles are flat on y = 0. Ankle joints wear a gold cuff band with one small stud. Rear thighs get a subtle cream patch. Every leg also carries one thin sumi outline strip down its front face for the print line work.
parts.attaches: Each hip joint sockets into the body part at socketFL/FR/HL/HR, the leg tube roots buried into the barrel's belly skin; feet stand flat on the floor, the model's lowest points.

parts.builds: The mane crest and ox tail. Mane: a crest of broad blades running along the spine from the shoulder (z 1.2) back to the rump (z -1.2), rooted along maneMount on the body's topline — a solid low swept base ridge (indigoDeep) plus 9-12 overlapping extruded blade fins rising ~0.35 above the back, each tilted slightly backward, coloured root-to-tip from indigoDeep through indigo to a sumi tip, with a gold edge strip on every third blade. Tail: a b.chain of tail1..tail3 sweeping from tailMount up and back in an ox-like curve, radius ~0.09 tapering to 0.05, indigo, ringed with two thin gold bands, ending in a bold tuft at the tip: a cluster of 6-8 curved spike blades in cream and dreamGlow, the central ones softly glowing (glow ~1.0) as if carrying eaten dreams. Add two small cream rump patches and a sumi seam line where the tail meets the rump.
parts.attaches: The mane base sits on the body's topline along maneMount (y ~1.85) and the mane blades stand just above the body's back; the tail roots at tailMount on the rump and sweeps out behind the body's box, its tuft the rearmost piece of the model.

parts.builds: The dream being eaten. Four to six stylised ukiyo-e cloud wisps: flat extruded spiral-scroll shapes (the classic woodblock cloud with a curled end), mist with mistDeep outline edges, thickness ~0.02, floating at y 0.4-1.4 beside the flanks and one small bank low near the front left foot. Three glowing dream motes: small faceted octahedron/sphere parts in dreamGlow, glow() at strength 1.4, drifting in a loose spiral from the flank toward the trunk tip, nearest within ~0.15 of trunkMouth, each with a tiny gold trail bead behind it. Everything here floats free of the floor and never touches the body: keep all pieces at least 0.05 outside the body, legs and head surfaces. Sparse and elegant — the creature stays the hero.
parts.attaches: Static, no joints; the innermost mote points at trunkMouth where the trunk tip hovers; cloud banks hover just outside the legs' box and the body's flanks.

But stylized — tapir spirit. Malayan tapir has white saddle band across mid-body on black body. Baku in Japanese folklore often depicted as tapir-like with trunk.

Ukiyo-e style: flat bold colours, indigo/cream palette, wave-like cloud patterns, gold accents, ink outlines. Maybe a cloud-like mane, glowing dream wisps.

Size: a tapir spirit, maybe 2.4 wide, 2.2 high, 4.2 long. Let's say size [2.4, 2.3, 4.6].

Skeleton: spine chain, neck, head, jaw, trunk, four legs, tail, maybe ears. Joints list in spec: parents first. Let me define:

Let me set up: body length ~2.6 (trunk to rump), legs ~0.75 tall, body center y ~1.15. Head at front +Z with short trunk.
